name: cinebook-movie-booking-platform
description: Cinebook — Fullstack Hindi Movie Ticket Booking Platform Inspired by BookMyShow

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
